text:
Ava: Quick last-mile thread 12h before cut. We need final owners for SLA wording, docs quickstart, support handoff, monitoring + alerts, pricing stub + billing freeze. Keep it tight.

Mark: Ill own monitoring and alert rules. Proposed golden signals: per-route p95, 5xx rate, token-rate anomaly, cache_hit_rate. Alerts: p95 > 350ms for 5m, 5xx > 0.5% for 10m, token_spike > 30% for 10m. I'll post the dashboard JSON.

Priya: Docs owner here. Deliverables: JS/Python quickstart, streaming reconnect example, errors table and a short "what's not in GA" callout. I'll add an onboarding checklist customers can run post-provision.

Sam: I'll take SLA + runbook. Draft tiers: Standard 99.5% (email), Business 99.8% (8h P1), Enterprise 99.95% (2h P1 + AM). Runbook will include fallback routing to smaller model when p95 > 400ms for 3 checks. Need Legal to confirm credit wording.

Priya: Pricing note: GA = flat per-token + embedding unit. Add an "early pilot" coupon and a billing-freeze endpoint for disputed invoices. FinOps sign-off required.

Mark: I'll add synthetic streaming smoke tests on deploy and a short playbook: if token_cost_delta > 25% page ops and trigger billing-freeze workflow.

Ava: Scope call: cut custom quantization and latency-aware autoscale from GA. Mark both as alpha in docs and include migration steps. Everyone ok?

Sam: Agree. We'll ship stable routing, model variants, and clear runbooks.

Priya: Docs will show "alpha" badge and include a migration checklist for quantized artifacts.

launch-bot: Canary scheduled: tomorrow 03:15 UTC. Reminder: run synthetic smoke, validate token accounting, and link all checklist PRs.

Mark: Owners recap: Monitoring  Mark; Docs  Priya; SLA + runbook  Sam; Pricing + billing-freeze  Priya + FinOps. I'll upload dashboard and alert rules in the next hour.

legal-bot: Legal note: SLA credit formula needs a cap and an exclusion clause. Sam, submit the draft for quick review.

Ava: Final pre-merge checklist for launch PRs: 1) SLA doc link; 2) runbook + escalation matrix; 3) docs quickstart + migration notes; 4) monitoring dashboard + alert rules; 5) pricing stub + FinOps ack. All five must be linked 12h before canary. If green we cut.

Priya: I'll post docs PR now and add the customer checklist.

Sam: Posting SLA + runbook draft to thread. Legal, please review ASAP.

Mark: Dashboard uploaded and linked. Adding alert playbook now.

Ava: Thanks team 1 I'll send the owners email and watch for green links.
